versions.changelog:
- Expanded publication management: added support for deleting publications with usage guidance and edge cases.
- Featured image workflow improved: now covers listing/importing images (assets) and updating article header images post-generation.
- Enhanced CTA editing: clarified structure, added side page linkage support, and warned about new strict server-side validation (malformed payloads are now rejected).
- Added partial and advanced update/field details for `update_blog_article`, including language and image fields.
- Documented the effects of language code usage and external asset handling.
- Removed the redundant/obsolete `skill-card.md` file.

Initial release of PostKing Blog skill for managing the full blog article lifecycle.

- Create, edit, and organize blog publications.
- Generate, review, iterate on, and publish articles to PostKing-hosted blogs or external platforms (WordPress, Medium, Substack).
- Provides async blog post generation, real-time status tracking, and partial updates.
- CLI commands available for fast management of publications and articles.
- Designed for use with an active brand; integrates with other PostKing skills for complete workflow coverage.
